_meta.paper: Diebold, F.X. & Mariano, R.S. (1995) 'Comparing Predictive Accuracy', Journal of Business & Economic Statistics, 13(3), pp. 253-263
_meta.equation: DM = d_bar / sqrt(LRV/T), where d_t = L(e1_t) - L(e2_t), d_bar = mean(d_t), LRV = long-run variance of d_t
_meta.note: No Harvey, Leybourne & Newbold (1997) small-sample correction applied (negligible for T>200)
_meta.tolerance: abs=0.5 for z-stat (sampling variability), exact for structural properties

identical_losses.description: When both forecasts have identical loss, d_t = 0 for all t, so DM = 0 and p_value ~ 1

dominant_model.description: When model 1 has consistently lower loss (d_t > 0 always), DM should be large positive with p << 0.05
dominant_model.test_approach: Create losses1 = small constants, losses2 = large constants

symmetry.description: DM(model1, model2) = -DM(model2, model1) in statistic, same p-value
symmetry.test_approach: Swap loss arguments, verify stat flips sign
